ANSWER: YES
HALLUCINATIONS:
- “a syndicate of eight lenders led by Bank of America” — the source lists Bank of America plus eight additional lenders (nine in total).
- “supported by a ... syndicate of eight major financial institutions” — same issue; the lender group comprises nine institutions including Bank of America.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS:
- Full Applicable Rate grid details:
  - Commitment fee percentages by pricing level
  - Margins for Base Rate, Alternative Currency Term Rate, Alternative Currency Daily Rate, and Letters of Credit by pricing level
  - Provision that failure to deliver a Compliance Certificate can trigger Pricing Level 1 upon Required Lenders’ request
  - Initial Applicable Rate set at Pricing Level 2 from the amendment effective date until delivery of the FY2024 Compliance Certificate
- Canadian Dollar benchmark changes:
  - Adoption of Term CORRA for CAD loans and deletion of CDOR
  - Term CORRA Adjustments: 0.29547% (1-month) and 0.32138% (3-month)
- Interest Period change for CAD loans: only 1- or 3-month terms available
- Precise definition of the First Amendment Period end (tied to delivery of financial statements and Compliance Certificate for the fiscal quarter ending January 25, 2025)
- Detailed pro forma leverage conditions for corporate actions:
  - Permitted Acquisitions: ≤3.50x during the First Amendment Period; thereafter at least 0.25x below the max in Section 7.13(b)
  - Permitted Investments: ≤3.50x during the First Amendment Period; thereafter at least 0.25x below the max in Section 7.13(b)
  - Restricted Payments: ≤3.00x during the First Amendment Period; thereafter at least 0.25x below the max in Section 7.13(b)
- Adjustment Period constraints tied to Qualified Acquisitions:
  - Temporary covenant increase to 3.75x for four quarters
  - At least two subsequent quarters at ≤3.25x before another Adjustment Period
  - No more than two Adjustment Periods during the term
